topic: Joshua Greene (2001, 2008) fMRI Trolley vs Footbridge Dilemma Dual-Process Moral Psychology (dLPFC Utilitarian Control vs vmPFC/Amygdala Emotional Alarm) & Koenigs (2007) Lesion Proof (Low-Poly Pastel v7)
